entries.title: Leviticus 3:1
segments: ¶'When his offering [is] a sacrifice of a peace offering, if he offers [it] of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:2
segments: 'And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it [at] the door of the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood all around on the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:3
segments: 'Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:4
segments: 'the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe [attached] to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;

entries.title: Leviticus 3:5
segments: 'and Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which [is] on the wood that [is] on the fire, [as] an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:6
segments: ¶'If his offering as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the LORD [is] of the flock, [whether] male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:7
segments: 'If he offers a lamb as his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:8
segments: 'And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:9
segments: 'Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as an offering made by fire to the LORD, its fat [and] the whole fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone. And the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:10
segments: 'the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe [attached] to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;

entries.title: Leviticus 3:11
segments: 'and the priest shall burn [them] on the altar [as] food, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:12
segments: 'And if his offering [is] a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:13
segments: 'He shall lay his hand on its head and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:14
segments: 'Then he shall offer from it his offering, as an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:15
segments: 'the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe [attached] to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;

entries.title: Leviticus 3:16
segments: 'and the priest shall burn them on the altar [as] food, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma; all the fat [is] the LORD'S.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:17
segments: '[This shall be] a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither fat nor blood.'"
